title: Which parts of a procedure belong in prose and which in deterministic tools?
question: Which parts of a procedure belong in prose and which in deterministic tools?
answer:
V3-10C: Keep spec-workbench.mjs focused and manifest-aware; retain the source-catalog test; add only a layout/manifest check and a bounded installed-skill check/install/update helper. Each markdown procedure invokes only its relevant mechanical check; "there is no umbrella lifecycle program."
V3-23: Guidebook-first. Agents work through small markdown procedures that explain purpose, inputs, decisions, actions, stopping conditions, and proof; .mjs tools exist only for narrow deterministic checks that are clearer and safer as code.
V3-23A: No. Keep spec-workbench.mjs bounded to spec/ticket mechanics and avoid a monolithic lifecycle program.
